Finding: Time-horizon analysis did not fit Remote Labor Index data: model pass rates were flat to slightly rising as the human professional's completion time increased, rather than declining, so the assumption that longer human tasks are harder for AI does not hold across the diverse distribution of remote work RLI covers.
